name: Biomedical Sciences PhD (Morningside Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences)
detailsNote: Official information available. The only deadline found, December 1 for the Umbrella PhD, is printed without a year, so it is not confirmed for Fall 2027. The Apply page says Fall 2027 applications are open for the "PhD in Basic Biomedical Sciences Umbrella"; confirm that this is the same program. The pages give no application fee amount or fee-waiver information.
summary: Umbrella biomedical sciences PhD at the Morningside Graduate School. Students do up to three research rotations in the first year and are not limited to one department.

publishedDeadlines.label: Umbrella PhD application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: The admissions FAQ lists "Umbrella PhD: Dec. 1" for fall entry, by 11:59pm (EST), with no year. Confirm the Fall 2027 date with the program.

timeline.interviews: Qualified candidates are contacted by email for an interview after application review.

english.toefl: 100 total, with 17 or higher on each subsection
english.note: The FAQ says the admissions committees look for these scores (IELTS with no subscore lower than 6.5). International applicants submit unofficial TOEFL or IELTS scores with the application; official scores are required before matriculation.

documents: Unofficial transcripts from every college or university attended
Course-by-course evaluated transcript from a NACES member (international applicants)
requirements.note: The GRE is not required nor considered. A fee is required with the application, but the pages give no amount and no waiver information.

funding.note: The funding page lists the current annual stipend (2025-2026) as $41,607, with a full waiver of tuition and fees and health and basic dental insurance at no cost. The pages do not say whether this covers international students.

international.note: International applicants submit a course-by-course evaluated transcript and TOEFL or IELTS scores.
